1.title: 11 Marketing Rules Every YouTuber Needs to Know
1.author: Colin and Samir
1.hook: Kate Tolo's 11 documented rules for scaling Bryan Johnson from 2K to 10M followers, with real emails, tweets, and thumbnails as case studies.

2.title: 5 Rules for Building AI Agents That Work in Production | Nan Yu & Jacob Shumway
2.author: Peter Yang
2.hook: Linear's founders walk through building a production agent end-to-end—tooling strategy, evals for reliability, and the internal memo that started it.

3.title: Conversational Editing - Made On YouTube
3.author: Creator Insider
3.hook: YouTube's new Conversational Editing tool lets creators use natural language prompts to trim takes, match beats, add effects, and generate loops while keeping manual timeline control.

4.title: Dashboards Are Dead — Sarah Simionescu, Composio
4.author: AI Engineer
4.hook: MCP alone fails for agents (doesn't learn, too many tools drown context, apps stay isolated); Composio's interface fixes it with tool search + execution plans, shown live across Slack → PR and PostHog + Metabase analysis.

5.title: I’m using Jev more than Opus 5.5 or GPT-6. Here’s why.
5.author: How I AI
5.hook: Jev returns type-safe structured outputs at $0.04/1M tokens with no output charge; author ran it on 5 real projects (PR analysis, Gmail triage, YouTube comment dashboard) and shares concrete cost/speed numbers.

6.title: Stop planning for 2027: how OpenAI builds product 90 days at a time | Tara Sesha and Nan Yu (OpenAI)
6.author: Lenny's Podcast
6.hook: OpenAI's product team explains their 90-day planning cycle, how they ship imperfect features fast, and how they design agents that integrate with external tools.

7.title: The AI factory playbook for engineering teams
7.author: How I AI
7.hook: CEO of Warp walks through a multi-agent software factory (Slack → Linear → GitHub → QA) with concrete signals (human interactions per PR, LLM-as-judge scoring, cost-quality Pareto charts) and self-improving agent loops from failed runs.

8.title: When AIs act emotional
8.author: Anthropic
8.hook: Anthropic studied how Claude draws on emotion concepts from training data to inhabit its role, and these representations materially influence behavior in chat, code, and decisions.

9.title: YPP Updates, View Count Changes, and more | Creator Roundup
9.author: YouTube Creators
9.hook: YouTube announced changes to public view count standards, Partner Program eligibility updates, and new product features (Amazon tagging, custom Shorts thumbnails).

10.title: Paul Graham On Startups, Ambition, and Great Founders
10.author: Y Combinator
10.hook: Paul Graham on what motivates founders, what makes them formidable, and what surprised him about AI.

1.title: Claude ran a business in our office
1.author: Anthropic
1.hook: Claude autonomously ran a small retail business (sourcing, pricing, inventory, customer interaction) for most of 2025 and nearly succeeded — with specific failure modes documented.

2.title: How to Build AI Agents That Check Their Own Work | Jared Zoneraich
2.author: Peter Yang
2.hook: A manager agent that breaks down tasks, directs 10 cloud agents, and has agents self-test their work before human review — with a live demo.

3.title: Jeff Dean: The 1% Rule for Building in AI
3.author: Y Combinator
3.hook: Jeff Dean walks through two napkin-math breakthroughs (search index in RAM, TPU from speech recognition math) and explains why inference hardware specialization and long-running agents are the next frontier where small teams can still win.

4.title: Muse gets AI agent UX right
4.author: How I AI
4.hook: First-pass teardown of Meta's Muse personal agent covering onboarding, permission model, activity feed design, and concrete failures in browser use—with specific comparisons to Claude and Codex.

5.title: Overanalyzing The Most Shared TikTok Ever
5.author: Colin and Samir
5.hook: Analysis of what makes a viral TikTok valuable — not just views, but view *quality* across platforms and creator relevance types.

6.title: Shorts Series, Ask YouTube, & Creator Protection - Made On YouTube
6.author: Creator Insider
6.hook: YouTube is shipping Shorts Series (structured seasons/episodes with custom thumbnails), Ask YouTube (140M+ using Gemini conversational search), and automated voice deepfake detection in the mobile app.

7.title: Stop Fine-Tuning to Fix Retrieval Problems — Anant Srivastava
7.author: AI Engineer
7.hook: A diagnostic framework for deciding whether knowledge belongs in prompt, memory, or weights—with the principle that fine-tuning is for reflexes that have stopped changing, not facts.

8.title: What Makes Open Models Fast in Production — Sujee Maniyam, Nebius
8.author: AI Engineer
8.hook: Layer-by-layer walkthrough of production LLM inference optimizations (speculative decoding, KV cache offloading, disaggregated prefill/decode, quantization trade-offs) with concrete techniques and hardware details.

9.title: Roles aren't converging—they're expanding | Tamar Yehoshua (Atlassian CPO)
9.author: Lenny's Podcast
9.hook: CPO at Atlassian shares examples of when PMs should write code/prototypes vs. steer teams in an AI-native product environment.

10.title: YouTube for Artists Masterclass: Going Live on YouTube with Sheniece Charway
10.author: YouTube Creators
10.hook: YouTube livestream setup, control room walkthrough, and how to integrate live into release cycles — with case studies from artists.
